about: Commission and mix pay plans (PayPlans.swift). Game design values, not from a source. `modes`: "mix" is a lower salary (`baseShare` of the going pay for their skill) plus commission at `defaultRate`; "com" is commission only: NO base pay at all (owner rule), at `defaultRate`. `rateSteps` are the commission shares a plan can be set to. `extraRoles` lists, per trade, the jobs outside the general sales roles (tables.json SALES_ROLES) that sensibly sell on commission there: shop assistants where the shop's takings come from what they sell, recruiters in staffing, advisers in a bank, ticket desk staff at an airline, rental agents. Commission is on the revenue attributed to the person, as for every seller. A trade with no sellers of its own (no travel agency or recruitment-only trade exists in the trade list) has no entry.
